mapper.insert: INSERT INTO policy (id, policy_no, holder_name, product_type, premium, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{policyNo}, #{holderName}, #{productType}, #{premium}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, policy_no, holder_name, product_type, premium, status, created_at, updated_at FROM policy ORDER BY id DESC
